postings.title: Accounts Payable Admin
postings.text:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.


About the Role
Accounts Payable Administrator
We are looking for an Accounts Payable Clerk for our accounting department to look after payment transactions and the financial commitments of our group. You will need to maintain ledgers, oversee tax-related processes, maintain spreadsheets and databases of valuable information and uphold the company’s policies and image with suppliers, therefore contributing to its growth..
Fixed Term Contract for 6 Months           
Location: To be based in South Africa 
Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work in a hybrid environment with regular attendance at the office. 
Hours:Weekday - Monday to Friday (5 working days) from 8am to 5pm
Flexibility with work hours: 
While this is a full time Monday to Friday,  standard business hours position, the nature of the work requires a degree of flexibility. The individual should be prepared to occasionally support meetings outside of standard working hours, given the global scope of the team.


 RESPONSIBILITIES
•

Exposure to Inter-Company payables

•

Exposure to Foreign Currency Transactions

•

Exposure to accounting processes, client servicing, etc.

•

Learning how to organize, multitask and manage time.

•

Learn on the job regarding the best practices in accounting.

•

Exposure to the field of accounting and its various responsibilities.

•

Assisting the group CFO and finance managers on ad hoc tasks related to NetSuite

•

This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of duties but is intended to reflect a range of duties the post-holder will mainly perform. The job description will be reviewed regularly and may be changed in the light of experience and in consultation with the post-holder.

Qualifications

•

Matric

•

Diploma in financial accounting will be desirable

Experience

•

5 years working in Accounting Roles of similar nature

•

Foreign Currencies

•

Experience of working in a high growth environment

•

Proven experience of managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines and using judgment and initiative in problem resolution

•

Working with NetSuite

•

Working with any other ERP system

Skills

•

Excellent attention to detail

•

Excellent Spreadsheet and Data Knowledge

•

High levels of personal integrity

•

Excellent Communication Skills

Knowledge

•

IT systems knowledge –

•

Knowledge and understanding of data and its uses within a corporate environment.

•

Netsuite

postings.title: Financial Consultant - Philippines
postings.text:
About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.


Role Description
This is an associate role supporting Lyra Health’s delivery of employee wellbeing services in the Philippines. In this role, you will provide brief financial consultation to clients (via telephonic settings), while adhering to Lyra’s clinical and service standards. 
Associates will receive client referrals from Lyra and are expected to manage their session scheduling, maintain timely and accurate documentation, and ensure a high standard of care. The role involves periodic coordination with Lyra’s care and operations team to support seamless service delivery and a positive client experience.


Requirements:
• Professional Qualification: Must be a Registered Financial Planner and is able to practice in the Philippines.

• Experience in providing financial consultation

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to maintain professional standards, confidentiality, and ethical practice

• Timely completion of documentation and administrative requirements

• Comfortable using digital tools/platforms for sessions and case management

• Ability to work independently while maintaining communication with a remote team

• Fluency in English; additional local languages are an advantage

Here are some of the advantages to joining the Lyra provider network:
• Connect with highly compatible clients thanks to Lyra’s powerful matching algorithm technology

• Flexibility to set your own schedule

• Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround

• Access Lyra’s experienced clinical consultations team to get rapid support with your Lyra clients as well as access a range of specialty group consultation meetings

• Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for crisis support

• Stay in the know with monthly newsletters and robust Help Center resources just for Lyra providers

• Access to exclusive provider events with Lyra’s clinical leaders

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.
By applying for this contract position, your data will be processed as per Workforce Privacy Notice. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form.  This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Sr. Accounting Transformation Lead
postings.text:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 


About the Role: 
The Sr. Accounting Transformation Lead is responsible for supporting the SVP, Global Controller to advance the maturity, scalability, and effectiveness of the company's accounting operating model. This role will partner closely with the global leadership team to identify, prioritize, plan and execute accounting transformational initiatives that support the company's growth and long-term strategic objectives.
With the Global Controller, this leader will co-develop and drive accounting transformation spanning organizational design, process standardization, technology enablement, public-company readiness. The successful candidate will combine proven experience in accounting and strategy development, change management, operational excellence.  Sr. Accounting Transformation Lead should have exceptional project management skills along with exceptional communication experience and demonstrated success with delivering excellence for stakeholders.


Responsibilities
Accounting Transformation Strategy

•

Assess current-state capabilities across people, processes, technology, data, governance, and controls and identify opportunities to strengthen the accounting operating model.

•

Translate strategic priorities into project plans with measurable objectives, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and expected business outcomes.

Process Excellence & Global Standardization

•

Identify opportunities to simplify, harmonize, automate, and strengthen core accounting processes, including record-to-report, financial close, reconciliations, consolidation, intercompany accounting, financial reporting, and other controllership activities.

•

Manage the development of clearly defined roles, responsibilities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations.

•

Partner with accounting leaders to reduce manual processes, eliminate unnecessary complexity, improve close efficiency, and strengthen the quality and timeliness of financial information.

Technology Automation

•

Identify opportunities to leverage automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, workflow solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, controls, and decision-making.

•

Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize investments, and ensure successful design and implementation of finance technology solutions.

•

Promote simplification and standardization of systems and data while reducing reliance on fragmented tools and manual processes.

Public Company Readiness

•

Project manage the critical accounting readiness activities associated with SEC-compliant financial reporting, disclosure processes, close and reporting timelines, supporting documentation, and reporting governance.

•

Identify and assist in resolving gaps that could impact IPO timing or sustainable public-company operations.

Change Leadership

•

Provide clear, concise reporting to senior leadership regarding transformation priorities, progress, risks, decisions, and resource requirements.

•

Lead change-management efforts necessary to drive adoption of new processes, technologies, organizational structures, and ways of working.

•

Build strong relationships across functions and geographies and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

•

Promote continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence across the global Accounting organization.

Qualifications
•

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field; CPA strongly preferred.

•

Approximately 12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, finance transformation, with significant leadership experience in complex, high-growth organizations.

•

Experience leading large-scale Finance or Accounting transformation initiatives involving multiple functions, geographies, systems, and stakeholders.

•

Demonstrated experience redesigning and standardizing accounting processes and operating models.

•

Strong understanding of finance technology ecosystems, including ERP, consolidation, financial reporting, close management, reconciliation, workflow, automation, and data/analytics solutions.

•

Prior experience in public accounting and/or a large, complex multinational organization is a plus.

postings.title: Vice President, Global Accounting
postings.text:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 


Responsibilities
Corporate Accounting & Financial Reporting

•

Provide leadership and oversight across corporate accounting, general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, lease accounting, consolidations, and related accounting operations.

•

Lead consolidated financial reporting ensuring timely and accurate financial results in accordance with U.S. GAAP .

•

Establish and maintain accounting policies, governance, and processes and lead the evaluation and implementation of new accounting standards.

•

Deliver meaningful financial information and insights to support executive decision-making.

Public Company & SOX Readiness

•

Support the design and implementation of a scalable SOX compliance framework, including strong business-process controls, governance, documentation, and accountability.

•

Strengthen the accounting organization’s infrastructure across close and consolidation, SEC-quality financial reporting, accounting policies, technical accounting, internal controls, systems, documentation, and audit readiness.

Accounting Operations & Transformation

•

Lead the standardization and optimization of accounting processes globally, establishing clear ownership, performance expectations, service levels, and measurable outcomes.

•

Champion continuous improvement and identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, simplify processes, accelerate cycle times, and improve the quality and accessibility of financial information.

•

Bring a technology-forward mindset to Accounting, identifying opportunities to leverage automation, AI, standardized workflows, and modern financial systems to improve speed, accuracy, scalability, controls, and insight.

Treasury & Cash Management

•

Strengthen processes supporting cash visibility, liquidity management, cash positioning, and working capital optimization.

•

Develop recommendations that support effective capital deployment, liquidity management, and financial risk management.

Leadership & Business Partnership

•

Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing accounting organization building organizational depth, leadership capability, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth.

•

Create an environment that attracts, develops, engages, and retains exceptional accounting talent.

•

Build strong partnerships to drive alignment and successfully execute cross-functional initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will mean building upon Lyra’s accounting foundation and transforming the organization for its next stage of growth. This leader will help create:

•

A scalable, high-performing global accounting organization with strong leadership depth and clear accountability.

•

A faster, more predictable, and increasingly automated financial close.

•

Standardized global accounting processes supported by strong systems, data, and controls.

•

Financial reporting and accounting infrastructure capable of operating at public-company standards.

•

A robust and sustainable SOX and internal-control environment.

•

Greater use of technology, automation, and AI across accounting workflows.

•

An accounting organization recognized as a trusted, strategic partner to the business.

Qualifications
•

Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex issues, resolve escalations, and drive alignment across functions.

•

15+ years of progressive accounting experience with demonstrated success leading and developing complex accounting organizations in a global environment.

•

Public-company accounting experience; a deep understanding of U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements, SOX and audit requirements.

•

Demonstrated success leading accounting transformation, process standardization, automation, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA required.

•

A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
